title: Stub measurements, version 1 (millimetres)
description: Structural checks only. The scaler also rejects any section whose circumference is not between 2 x and pi x its max width (plus tolerance).

length_mm.description: Straight distance along the stub's length direction from the selected base to the furthest tip.

circumference_mm.description: Tape loop perpendicular to the length direction at fraction x length from the base.

max_width_mm.description: Largest straight-across span of the same cross-section (caliper or parallel straightedges).
